rows.quote: GWAS data on IBD and its subtypes were obtained from public R10 data released from the FinnGen study, including 9083 patients with IBD and 403,098 controls, 2205 patients with CD and 392,974 controls, and 5931 patients with UC and 405,386 controls (the period of this study was 2017–2023 ) (Table S2).
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the public R10 data release of the FinnGen study.
